about: Every upstream file the platform layer work edits (touched) or no longer runs while a surface switch is on (shadowed), see ADR-0014. Shadowed files are grouped by the setting of the switch that shadows them; a surface that has left its switch keeps its old files shadowed, unrouted, under `unrouted<Surface>` (ADR-0018). A change that touches or shadows an upstream file adds it here in the same commit; `pnpm run report-platform-layer-upstream` lists what upstream changed in them.

touched.reason: the registry check and upstream report scripts; dev dependencies for renderer tests (jsdom, Vue test utils, the single file component plugin)
lockfile entries for the renderer test dev dependencies
the PeerTube download IPC channels (PEERTUBE_DOWNLOAD, _CANCEL, _REVEAL, _DISMISS, _LIST_DOWNLOADS)
accepts an optional `videoUrl`, validated as a PeerTube watch URL by src/main/peertubeExternalPlayer.js, when there is no valid YouTube `videoId`; handed to the player without playlist arguments

onBeforeSendHeaders hands every request to the PeerTube User-Agent helper (src/main/peertubeRequests.js) first; registers the PeerTube download handlers (src/main/peertubeDownloads/ipc.js) next to the yt-dlp ones
the PeerTube download functions (peerTubeDownload, peerTubeCancel, peerTubeReveal, peerTubeDismiss, peerTubeListDownloads)

the deep link handler (`enableOpenUrl`) hands a `fjernsyn://` link to src/renderer/platform/entryPoints.js `openPeerTubeEntry` first, and to `handleYoutubeLink` only when that hands it back (always, while PeerTube is off); in-app link clicks unchanged

subscriptions through src/renderer/platform/subscriptionExchange.js: NewPipe import adds PeerTube channels (service 3), and PeerTube accounts as all their channels (resolved through getPlatformLayer), while PeerTube is on; YouTube CSV, JSON and OPML exports skip PeerTube stubs; NewPipe export writes them as service 3; the Fjernsyn history and playlist imports keep a PeerTube video's validated platform, host and thumbnails (src/renderer/platform/records.js) and skip one without a valid host or uuid; the YouTube history export skips PeerTube entries; YouTube paths unchanged
the experimental PeerTube toggle
a PeerTube channel links to its PeerTube route and shows its avatar, through src/renderer/platform/cards.js, and subscribes as its PeerTube stub (`channelPlatformFields`); YouTube channels unchanged
a user playlist's cover is a PeerTube first video's own thumbnail (src/renderer/platform/cards.js `coverThumbnail`)

hooks gated on a PeerTube record (src/renderer/platform/cards.js): watch and channel routes, thumbnail, canonical share entries in place of YouTube and Invidious ones, external player `videoUrl` with no playlist, no DeArrow, no SponsorBlock channel entry; the history entry, playlist item and quick bookmark it writes keep `platform`, `host` and `thumbnail` (and a plain-text description) through `platformRecordFields`
a playlist's cover is a PeerTube first video's own thumbnail (src/renderer/platform/cards.js `coverThumbnail`)
optional `channelPlatformFields` prop, spread into the stored channel stub (`platform`, `host` for PeerTube); YouTube callers pass nothing and store exactly `{ id, name, thumbnail }`

a PeerTube first video gives the cover its own thumbnail, and the cover link plays from the first YouTube video in the playlist, or with none opens the PeerTube video on its own watch route; the URL list export takes a PeerTube video's canonical URL; the YouTube CSV export skips PeerTube videos

the search bar (`goToSearch`, now async) hands its text to src/renderer/platform/entryPoints.js `openPeerTubeEntry` first, and to `getYoutubeUrlInfo` only when that hands it back (always, while PeerTube is off); for the layer's search page: the pill (src/renderer/components/LayerSearchPill) in place of the filter button, a plain search goes to the route src/renderer/components/LayerSearchPill/searchBox.js builds instead of one from the store's searchSettings, and an operator's values are the suggestions once its key and colon are typed
the next-video preview of a PeerTube item is its own thumbnail, or the placeholder; next, previous, loop and shuffle step over PeerTube items, which open on their own watch page
optional `platform` prop: no SponsorBlock and no YouTube HLS seek rule for other platforms; lowest variant when none is at or below the preferred quality
installs the platform layer (src/renderer/platform/vue.js) on the app

the PeerTube routes (the layer's watch, channel and search views) spread in from src/renderer/platform/routes.js; `/search/:query` renders the layer's search page (src/renderer/views/LayerSearchPage), imported in place of SearchPage, which stays in the tree unrouted (shadowed)
the PeerTube settings: enablePeerTube, peerTubeSearchSource, peerTubeShowNsfw; the layer search page's: defaultSearchScope, searchRememberedParameters, searchLatched
spreads in the PeerTube settings section (src/renderer/components/PeerTubeSettings/section.js), present only in Electron while PeerTube is on
the fork-only PeerTube and Layer Search strings

unroutedSearch.reason: upstream's search page, unrouted: `/search/:query` renders the layer's (src/renderer/views/LayerSearchPage); its backend fallback, paging and search history are ported to the layer's YouTube search (src/renderer/platform/youtube/search.js) and the new page. Also touched: a "Search PeerTube" link in the heading row, to the layer's PeerTube search view for the same query, shown only while PeerTube is on (isPeerTubeEnabled)

the search filters modal, never opened: its button in the top bar gives way to the pill (src/renderer/components/LayerSearchPill), and the filters are the chip bar (src/renderer/components/LayerSearchChips)

its `searchSettings` state and mutations only (the filters the modal writes and the top bar read), no longer read by the search box or the search page; the search query lives in the route (src/renderer/platform/search/query.js). The rest of the module is used as before
